home.about:
SONNI Group Advisory is a pan-African advisory firm dedicated to
strategy, intelligence, influence and investment. We support governments, institutions, embassies, companies and leaders in
designing and implementing high-impact strategies, combining vision,
expertise and a strong continental network.
With an integrated approach rooted in a deep understanding of the continent,
SONNI Group Advisory builds tailored solutions in strategy, business
diplomacy, institutional communication, leadership and investment
development.
Our mission: to strengthen African influence, support public and private
transformation and create connections that generate long-term value.
home.ceo:
SONNI Group Advisory was born from a simple conviction: Africa needs
platforms of intelligence, influence and investment capable of carrying an
ambitious vision for the continent.
Our firm combines strategic expertise, in-depth understanding of African
dynamics, analytical capacity, diplomatic relations, innovation,
communication and leadership. SONNI is more than a company: it is a
mission.
A mission of transformation, African integration, economic diplomacy and
support to institutions and leaders.
Through our poles, events and programs, we help build a stronger, better connected, more influential and more competitive Africa.
home.ceo_sub: Welcome to the SONNI universe - Think, Influence, Invest, Transform.
home.reference:
SONNI Group Advisory works with public institutions, embassies, regional
organisations, companies and leaders across Africa.
home.reference_sub:
These references reflect the quality of our assignments, the trust placed in
our firm and our commitment to excellence.

about.title: OUR OFFICE
about.subtitle: SONNI Group Advisory is a pan-African institutional advisory firm specialised in :
about.services:
• Strategy & economic intelligence
• Communication, public relations & influence
• Business diplomacy & investment
• Executive training & leadership
• Organization of continental strategic events
about.footer: Based in Dakar, the firm operates at the crossroads of political, economic and diplomatic dynamics on the continent, leveraging a broad network of public institutions, embassies, agencies, companies and African leaders.
about.leadership:
SONNI Group Advisory is founded and led by Mahamadou Chaïbou Maïga,
an expert in international relations, business diplomacy and strategic
intelligence, with a strong focus on African economic integration and
investment dynamics across the continent.
He has been operating for several years at the intersection of governments,
diplomatic institutions, private sector leaders, investors and regional
organisations, advising on issues related to geopolitics, economic
attractiveness, the AfCFTA, influence strategies and the international
positioning of African stakeholders.
He is also the Founder and President of the Africa Invest & Integration
Forum, a pan-African strategic platform bringing together public decision-
makers, diplomats, corporate leaders and investors to address key challenges related to investment, regional integration and economic diplomacy in
Africa.

The governance of SONNI Group Advisory is grounded in the principles of

and sustainable value creation for the institutions and organisations we
advise.
